verdict: The biggest movement this period is a 1,000% spike in leads week-over-week (now 12 over 28 days), driving CPL down 91.32% to $195.79, most likely fueled by Meta's 444 clicks generating all 12 tracked leads while Google's Local Services Campaign absorbed $1,677.52 of the $2,349.44 total spend with only 7 conversions. GBP activity pulled back 68.57% week-over-week despite 26 calls and 94 total actions in the 28-day window, suggesting the lead surge was channel-concentrated rather than broad-based.

performance.verdict: Meta is the only channel converting; Google spend unverified and SOW build critically overdue.

findings.text: 5 overdue SOW milestones (Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site Live, Ads Launch, Meta Retargeting) — all due Jul 31–Aug 1, none completed per record.
Meta generated all 12 leads on $641.67 spend (CPL $53.47); Google Ads absorbed $1,707.77 with only 7 logged conversions and 34 clicks — efficiency gap is 7x.
3-day lead signal (Sep 8–10: 2+1+4=7 leads) vs prior 3 days (Sep 5–7: 1+1+1=3) is sharply rising, driven entirely by Meta spend averaging $64.86/day.
GBP actions hit zero for 4 straight days (Sep 7–10) after averaging 4.4/day the prior 3 weeks — organic visibility has stalled with no clear cause in the data.
GHL shows 60 opportunities created but 0 won, 0 appointments, and GA4 records 0 conversions — 12 ad leads are not progressing to intake, suggesting a pipeline intake leak.

suggestions.text: Raise Meta daily budget +20% (~$13/day) to press $53.47 CPL while 3-day lead momentum holds.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta is the sole lead-generating channel at a CPL of $53.47 vs Google's implied $243.97, and the last 3 days produced 7 of the 12 28-day leads. Raise Meta daily budget by approximately $13/day (roughly +20% from the current ~$64.86/day average). Success check: CPL stays below $100 and lead pace holds at 2+ per day by 2026-09-18. If CPL climbs above $120 within 5 days, revert the increase.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL pipeline: 60 opps created, 0 won, 0 appointments — confirm intake routing and speed-to-lead under 5 min.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 60 opportunities created but zero appointments booked and zero won in the 28-day window, meaning leads are arriving but not converting to consultations. Nacer to audit routing rules, auto-reply triggers, and calendar booking links end-to-end. Success check: at least 5 appointments booked within 7 days of fix, confirmed in GHL by 2026-09-18.

suggestions.text: Watch Google LSA spend ($1,677.52, 7 conversions) for one more 7-day window before any budget decision.
suggestions.monday_update: Google's Local Services Campaign has absorbed $1,677.52 over 28 days with only 7 logged conversions and 34 clicks, but pixel and conversion tracking setup is listed as an overdue SOW milestone — the true conversion count may be understated. Do not kill or shift this budget until tracking is confirmed live and a clean 7-day read is available. Re-check on 2026-09-18 with verified conversion data.
